title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Infrastructure - BikeSharingStation
description: A Facility specialization for shared-bicycle stations (edintinf:EstacionBicicleta). Like Parking, the source ontology defines no attributes of its own beyond those inherited from Facility. Check for overlap with any existing bike-sharing SDM model before promoting this candidate.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'BikeSharingStation'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Point providing the geographical position of the entity.

coordinates.description: Property. Coordinates of the Point, in WGS84 [longitude, latitude] order.

infrastructureType.description: Relationship. Reference to a concept of the InfrastructureType controlled vocabulary (234 concepts covering education, culture, sports, health, social and parking facility types; see kos/skos-InfrastructureType.ttl in the source ontology). Too large to enumerate as a fixed list; kept as a Relationship to the concept URI.

belongsTo.description: Relationship. Territorial unit (e.g. city district / 'Barrio') the facility belongs to. Defined in an external territorial ontology not included in the source repository; kept as an opaque Relationship.

containsFacility.description: Relationship. Other Facility entities physically contained within this one (e.g. an exhibition hall inside a cultural center).

hasObservationPoint.description: Relationship. The ObservationPoint(s) associated with this facility, where access or counting sensors are deployed.

hasRegisteredOwner.description: Relationship. The Organization that is the registered owner of this facility.

openingHours.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/openingHours'. The general opening hours, e.g. 'Mo,Tu,We,Th,Fr 08:00-18:00'.

items.description: Property. Regular activity offered at the facility, from the RegularActivity controlled vocabulary.

regularActivity.description: Property. Regular activity offered at the facility, from the RegularActivity controlled vocabulary.

items.description: Property. Public service provided by the facility, from the PublicService controlled vocabulary.

publicService.description: Property. Public service provided by the facility, from the PublicService controlled vocabulary.
